# Recreation Prompt

Recreate Cozy Permit Kingdom as a portrait-first browser game: a mechanically faithful real-time graph territory strategy game reframed as a cozy satirical city-builder tycoon. The player taps a starter plot, starts the match, then drags from owned cottage districts to adjacent districts to send half their builders as permit parades. Districts produce builders over time; allied arrivals reinforce, rival arrivals damage and may capture. City hall captures merge whole rival councils. A Nap Truce cooldown temporarily prevents rival attacks on the player. Preserve speed, pause, restart, win when all rivals are merged, and loss when the player has no districts or outgoing builders. Visually use fairycore/cottagecore/decora kei pastel scenery, cute city hall silhouettes, dashed zoning roads, candy UI, cozy BGM/SFX, and mobile-readable one-thumb controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: real-time graph strategy / territory capture game.
- objective: choose a starting node, send half of an owned node's population/builders along adjacent edges, flip rival nodes by reducing them below zero, and win by owning or absorbing every rival faction.
- input model: one-thumb pointer/touch; tap a node during selection, then drag from an owned node to an adjacent target to dispatch half the source count. HUD buttons handle truce, speed, pause, resume, music, quit, and restart.
- core loop: nodes produce population over time, player and AI dispatch traveling units, impacts reinforce allied nodes or damage/capture enemy nodes, capitals can annex all remaining nodes of a faction, and state checks determine win/loss.
- fail/friction state: lose when the player has no owned nodes and no outgoing player units; friction comes from AI pressure, node caps, cooldown timing, adjacency restrictions, and depleted source counts.

## Protected Mechanics
- Same node polygons, graph edges, selection flow, drag-to-adjacent dispatch rule, half-count transfer, production rates, moving troop progress, hit/capture semantics, capital annex semantics, AI cadence, truce cooldown/duration, speed cycle, pause/restart, and win/loss checks are preserved.

## Remix Target
Cozy Permit Kingdom reframes the war-network graph as a satirical city-builder tycoon where cute city halls, cottage districts, rival councils, and permit parades compete to merge every pastel neighborhood before bedtime. Presentation, copy, palette, procedural drawing, and audio mood changed; gameplay rules did not.
